title: Settings
subtitle: Preferences that apply across the whole app.

webSearch.title: Web Search
webSearch.description: Sets whether web search starts on or off for new conversations. Each conversation keeps its own web search toggle in its chat header afterwards, so changing this setting never affects a conversation that already exists.
webSearch.note: Off by default. When a tool-capable model decides to search, the searched query is sent to external search engines — nothing else leaves your machine.

reasoningEffort.title: Default reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.description: Sets the starting reasoning effort for new conversations. Each conversation keeps its own reasoning effort control in its chat header afterwards, so changing this setting never affects a conversation that already exists.
reasoningEffort.note: Medium by default. Higher levels let the model deliberate more before answering; None asks it to answer directly.

autoUpdate.title: Automatic updates
autoUpdate.description: Check for a new version of Erudi in the background, download it and install it the next time you quit. The request goes to this project's GitHub releases and carries nothing but your version and platform.
autoUpdate.note: On by default. When off, the app makes no update request at all; you can still install a new version yourself from the releases page.

updates.title: Update Erudi
updates.description: Look for a new version now, download it and install it straight away. Installing closes Erudi and opens it again on the new version.
updates.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
updates.failed: The update could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
updates.unavailable: Updates are handled by the installed application; this build cannot check for them.

language.title: Application language
language.description: The language of menus, buttons and messages across the whole app. Model answers stay in whatever language you write in.
language.note: Applied immediately and remembered for the next launch. Set from your system language on first launch.

privacy.title: What leaves your machine
privacy.description: Models run on this computer and your conversations and documents stay on it. The page lists every network request the app can make, when it happens, and the code that proves it.

inferenceBackend.title: Inference engine
inferenceBackend.description: Choose whether Erudi runs models on the graphics card or on the processor. Automatic uses the graphics card whenever the driver supports it.
inferenceBackend.note: Erudi restarts its engine when this changes. The processor is slower but sidesteps the graphics card entirely.
